summary: Join our Artificial Intelligence for Internal Audit training course and gain valuable insights into integrating AI technologies for improved audit efficiency.
lede: Artificial Intelligence for Internal Audit helps professionals apply AI throughout the internal audit lifecycle, from risk assessment and audit testing to anomaly detection. The course shows how AI-enabled tools can support more efficient, accurate, and insight-driven assurance as data volumes and risks continue to grow. Participants learn to interpret AI outputs through professional judgment rather than becoming data scientists. They also explore ethical governance and audit standards so they can modernize audit practices while preserving independence, objectivity, and accountability.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals across sectors who are responsible for ensuring effective internal audit practices in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.
audience: Internal auditors in public, private, and NGO
Heads of Internal Audit and Audit Managers
modules: The Evolution of Internal Audit in the Age of AI
AI Fundamentals for Auditors (No Technical Jargon)
AI in Audit Planning and Risk Assessment
AI-Driven Audit Testing and Anomaly Detection
Fraud Detection and Forensic Auditing with AI
Auditing Automated Systems and AI-Driven Processes
Bias, Ethics, and Governance of AI in Audit
Managing Risk, Judgment, and Accountability in AI-Enabled Audits
Communicating AI-Enhanced Audit Insights to Stakeholders
prerequisites: Participants should have foundational knowledge in internal auditing and a basic understanding of data analysis concepts.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
